# Humanize Korean AI text — remove AI tells from Korean writing

Curated by Skill Harbor — @epoko77-ai's humanize-korean skill: a full workflow for making Korean AI-generated text read naturally. Ships detection heuristics for AI tells in Korean writing, natural Korean expressions and phrasing guidance, three rewrite routes (light, standard, heavy) matched to how "AI" the draft sounds, anti-patterns to avoid, and bundled scripts for detection and scoring. Honest caveats: Korean-specific — the heuristics and expressions don't transfer to other languages (see the separate humanizer fiches for English); rewriting to evade AI detectors is dual-use — fine for polishing your own drafts, don't use it to pass off generated work as human where that matters (exams, disclosures).
